mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% is followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% is followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the economy, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases are not followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases are followed by positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL rising are followed by positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strengthening labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases are followed by negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases are followed by positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and GDP (GDPC1) is expanding, it signals a robust supply side of the economy, which is typically associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rising and GDPC1 expanding are followed by negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.
